description:
Water extent lines for Tropical cyclone, Vanuatu, 3 April 2020 (TC20200403VUT): 5 features merged from 2 source layers. Lines layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Buildings Damage Assessment & Related Density in South of Sanma Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/buildings-damage-assessment-related-density-in-south-of-sanma-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in Ambae Island, Penama Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-ambae-island-penama-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in CanalFanafo, Luganville and South East Santo Municipalities, Sanma Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-canalfanafo-luganville-and-south-east-santo-municipalities-sanma-prov)
- [Damage Assessment in Luganville Municipality, Sanma Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-luganville-municipality-sanma-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in Maewo Island, Penama Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-maewo-island-penama-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in Malampa Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-malampa-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in Malo Island, Sanma Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-malo-island-sanma-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in Paama Island, Malampa Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-paama-island-malampa-province-vanuatu)
- [Damage Assessment in West Santo and South Santo Municipality, Sanma Province, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-west-santo-and-south-santo-municipality-sanma-province-vanuatu)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Exs
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Definite; 2 = Doubtful. The decoded text is in `Exs_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Sec
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Good; 2 = Marginal; 3 = Poor. The decoded text is in `Sec_label`.

table:columns.name: OpStatus
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Open; 2 = Restricted; 3 = Closed; 4 = Abandonned/Disused. The decoded text is in `OpStatus_label`.

table:columns.name: WtwTpe
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Unspecified; 1 = Open Water - Sea; 2 = Open Water - Lake; 3 = Open Water - Pond; 4 = Resevoir; 5 = Navigation in restricted waterways; 6 = River; 7 = Seasonal Stream; 8 = Stream; 9 = Canal. The decoded text is in `WtwTpe_label`.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Staff_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 11 = EB; 22 = WP; 33 = LB; 44 = JL; 55 = VG; 66 = CJ; 73 = RS; 77 = LD; 88 = HK; 99 = ER; 100 = KM; 111 = MBF; 121 = CN; 131 = SB; 141 = KJP; 151 = MNY; 222 = CS; 1000 = Unknown. The decoded text is in `Staff_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT 6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Komsat-2; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `Sensor_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Sensor_Date
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: Exs_label
table:columns.description: `Exs` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: OpStatus_label
table:columns.description: `OpStatus` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Sec_label
table:columns.description: `Sec` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Sensor_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Sensor_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Staff_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Staff_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: WtwTpe_label
table:columns.description: `WtwTpe` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
